seats.name: Serve the badly served, bet small
A shipment is a document first
Tax position, elections, and what survives examination
The moment of truth — the encounter that earns the next one
Hiring on evidence, paying for contribution, proving the process
Whether a figure is shown honestly or merely shown
The last planner — whether a schedule was committed to or only published
Variation is the enemy, and the process owns the defect
Scope, baseline and earned value — maturity over heroics
The unit must run identically without the founder in it
Landed cost is the only cost — ocean, air, duty, and the law that moves them
AI governance to a published standard, in every state
Peter Drucker

record.line: a span is not the thing it resembles
record.note: a person is name words with no title or role word; an officer sentence counts only with the company’s whole name. Proved on both failures and every admitted name; the zero-read re-scan then found STS Aviation Group’s President (Mark Smith, “President of STS Aviation Group”) and refused a TrakAmerica match taken from a feed page. A third instance means the extractor is rebuilt, not patched (Chair)
